Thermaltake Toughpower 550W Gold (Modular) The Thermaltake Toughpower series is a premium 80 PLUS Gold certified power supply that uses the highest quality components for stable performance, excellent features with unbeatable efficiency vital to the current high-end system in market even in demanding conditions. With the 80Plus Gold certification for its high power efficiency, and a single strong 12V rail flexibly routes the maximum available power to your CPU and graphics card, offering maximized power usage and easy setup. Toughpower 550W Gold (Modular) comes with modular design to reduce cable clutter; and ultra-quiet fan delivers silent cooling, thus the entire computer and power supply can operate at its peak moment.  Ultra Quiet 140mm Fan Toughpower 550W Gold series adopt 140mm cooling fan with intelligent fan speed control guarantees cool performance and silent operation. 80 PLUS Gold Certified and Kaby Lake-Ready Deliver up to 90% efficiency under real world load conditions to promise lowest power losses. In addition, Toughpower Gold Series is already prepared for Intel’s new, Seventh-generation Kaby Lake processor to achieve maximum energy savings.  Flat Modular Cables Toughpower 550W Gold series adopt flat modular cables not only eliminate cable clutter within the system, but takes up less space for better airflow. 100% High Quality Japanese Made Capacitors Japanese made capacitors provide uncompromised performance and reliability.
